mapper.select: SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.tenant_id, w.warehouse_nm, w.use_at, w.created_by, w.created_at, w.updated_by, w.updated_at FROM tb_warehouse w WHERE w.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
INSERT INTO tb_warehouse ( tenant_id, warehouse_nm, use_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{warehouseNm}, #{useAt}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) RETURNING warehouse_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_warehouse SET warehouse_nm = #{warehouseNm}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = now() WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
